name: Mega Evolution
author: eduardocalafell
description: In-battle Mega Evolution for Kanto/Johto Pokemon, done the honest way: a TEMPORARY battle transform (not a permanent evolution) that reverts when the battle ends, reusing the engine's own Transform machinery. Covers all 21 Gen 1/2 mega forms. Unlocked through quests: MEGARE, a researcher in Prof. Oak's Lab, sets a trial per Pokemon; clear it and he gives you that Pokemon's Mega Stone (a key item). Hold the stone and press SELECT (Tab) in battle to Mega Evolve, with a full transformation animation. Once per battle. Charizard and Mewtwo pick X or Y in the options. Depends on gen2_dex (pins the Pokedex bound; provides the Dark/Steel types). See QUESTS.md for every trial.
